description:
User approved 2026-11-18, verbatim via GC: "agreed; proceed". Step C5 of fz-9x7.11 page v4 (https://claude.ai/artifact/BB1FpQ1Cf7Jd5spZeLEWtg). One commit, judged on bench. Builder: GC.

Folded in by the user (relayed by GC, 2026-11-19; plan page v9 row C5): a collection writes its statistics into a slot its caller owns, rather than returning GcStats by value. At 264 bytes, LLVM moves GcStats with a memcpy call, about 54 instructions per collection. That is about 0.3 points of ring's +0.53% under fz-9x7.8; the ringres probe reproduced it on develop with two dummy fields added. Removal: the by-value GcStats return and its memcpy moves.

User approved the C5 page https://claude.ai/artifact/PDrPFkgEcVo44L64tP4CXW (relayed by GC 2026-11-24). It folds in fz-9x7.48; fz-9x7.47 stays separate.
title: A collection allocates nothing, and the park check is five instructions
